<thought>We have the CIF content of the chosen slab. To identify possible adsorption sites, we will call the get_adsorption_sites_text tool, providing the CIF string (with actual newline characters) as the argument. The tool will return a JSON description of the sites, which we will then save to adsorption_sites.json and return its path.</thought>
<action>get_adsorption_sites_text</action>
